_metadata.description: Control plane runs on macOS/Windows hosts; bridge written portable day one, full support gated on platform portability (P2).

requirements.title: Control Plane on macOS / Windows
requirements.description: The control plane itself runs on a macOS or Windows host, not only Linux. Bridge is written cross-platform from day one so it is never the blocker, but full support is gated on Vrooli-the-platform becoming installable/runnable on those OSes (a separate project-level track outside this scenario's scope). P2: designed and recorded as a future seam, not built here.

validation.notes: Recorded as a future seam (OT-P2-001) in the Phase 6 P2 table: bridge is written CGO_ENABLED=0 + cross-compiles for the full OS×arch matrix so it is never the blocker; the Mac/Win control plane itself is gated on the platform track. See also docs/internal/DECISIONS.md (single-owner fleet; control-plane-on-Mac/Windows is gated P2).
